description: JUnit test class 'SecretsTest' verifying encoding, decoding, and handling of different secret credential types within the org.eclipse.hono.service.management.credentials package.

classes.name: SecretsTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for testing secret-related credential encoding, decoding, and validation in the Hono project.

methods.name: testEncodePasswordSecret1
methods.description: Verifies encoding of a simple password secret into JsonObject, checking fields like salt, password hash, and comment.

methods.name: testEncodePskSecret
methods.description: Verifies encoding of a PSK secret, including binary key and date fields for not-before and not-after.

methods.name: testEncodeX509Credential
methods.description: Verifies encoding of an X509 credential with secrets and type fields.

methods.name: testDecodeGeneric
methods.description: Tests decoding a generic credential JSON object with unknown type, ensuring proper creation of credential and secret objects with additional properties.

methods.name: testDateFormats
methods.description: Tests handling of secret date fields with different ISO formats, ensuring correct parsing and encoding.
